tickerText: [TENNIS] Cincinnati QF day: Paul saves MP to upset Zverev 4-6, 7-6, 6-4; Fils blitzes de Minaur; Swiatek-Rybakina Toronto rematch headlines women's draw • [SQUASH] Sana Bahadar claims first PSA title at Bendigo Open; London Classic opens Sep 1 with defending champ Paul Coll • [BADMINTON] Delhi Worlds Day 4 — R16 as Sindhu faces Wang Zhi Yi and Ayush Shetty meets Alwi Farhan; Satwik-Chirag in men's doubles • [PICKLEBALL] 2026-27 PPA season opens Aug 31 at Veolia Nationals in Cary — debut of World Pickleball Rankings system • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Europe Smash wraps: Felix Lebrun claims first Grand Smash title; Wang Manyu wins third — Chinese men exit early in Malmö

newsItems.title: Cincinnati QFs: Paul Upsets Zverev
newsItems.excerpt: Tommy Paul saved a match point to beat top seed Alexander Zverev 4-6, 7-6, 6-4 as Cincinnati's quarterfinal lineup features a Swiatek-Rybakina rematch and an all-American Anisimova-Pegula clash.

newsItems.title: Bahadar Wins First PSA Title
newsItems.excerpt: Pakistan's Sana Bahadar captured her first PSA Tour title at the Bendigo Open, rallying past Rachael Grinham in four games — a breakthrough for the 20-year-old athlete.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026-27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off Aug 31 in Cary with the Veolia Pickleball National Championships — debuting the unified World Pickleball Rankings across all disciplines.

newsItems.title: Lebrun & Wang Manyu Crown Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: Felix Lebrun beat Tomokazu Harimoto 4-1 for his first WTT Grand Smash singles crown while Wang Manyu edged Wang Yidi 4-2 — as Chinese men failed to reach the quarters in Malmö.
